plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade reliable damage and defense; establish poison scaling, retain sufficient blocking, carry useful potions, and discard Beckon before its end-turn penalty.
plan.summary: Add immediate damage before taking elites, then build poison and efficient defense. Remove surplus Strikes once damage improves. Heal when needed for humidifier growth; otherwise upgrade impactful cards.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and efficient cycling

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and efficient cycling
plan.bossPrep: Acquire poison acceleration and stronger defense. Maintain Weak, reserve Wail for multihits, secure useful potions, and respect actual card limits including replays.
plan.summary: Keep the shop-before-elite route. Existing poison needs acceleration and defensive support, not more basic attacks. Spend gold on missing engines and potions; remove dilution. Heal now, upgrade impactful new components later.

plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Afterimage for innate first-card replay. Establish accelerated poison, dexterity, and reliable block; preserve HP and useful potions for consecutive bosses.
